messages.subject: help understanding the timer function
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

I am trying to use the timer() function to construct several timing measures from wav files. It looks great. I have a few questions that I'm hoping someone might be able to answer.

Here's an example wav file: https://www.dropbox.com/s/koqyfeaqge8t9iw/test.wav?dl=0

library(seewave)
w <- readWave("YOURPATHHERE/test.wav")
w
# Wave Object
# Number of Samples:      278528
# Duration (seconds):     6.32
# Samplingrate (Hertz):   44100
# Channels (Mono/Stereo): Stereo
# PCM (integer format):   TRUE
# Bit (8/16/24/32/64):    16

1. Am I calculating total signal duration (i.e., vocalization) correctly as the sum of s?

t0 <- timer(w, threshold=5)
sum(t0$s)
# [1] 1.168712

Just eyeballing this in Audacity, I would have guessed that my total vocalization (signal duration) is something more like 3-4 seconds.

 <https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/-KAc-hZC7XMA/VvWS0czzjNI/AAAAAAAAPiQ/hE8MP86wz7UldVnO-K0JMQEiAZZhEkzLg/s1600/Screenshot%2B2016-03-25%2B15.34.33.png>

2. I'm not certain how to use msmooth.

The package documentation describes it as:

> a vector of length 2 to smooth the amplitude envelope with a mean sliding window. The first component is the window length (in number of points). The second component is the overlap between successive windows (in %).

What is meant by "mean sliding window", "number of points", and "overlap between windows"?

I tried to determine the answer by experimenting a bit. The effect of increasing the window length is to increase the total signal period. Why? What is a good rationale for selecting a value for msmooth, especially when running in batch on thousands of files?

t1 <- timer(w, threshold=5, msmooth=c(10,0))
sum(t1$s)
# [1] 1.237041

t2 <- timer(w, threshold=5, msmooth=c(20,0))
sum(t2$s)
# [1] 1.494481

3. Am I using dmin correctly?

Next I add a parameter for dmin so that signal periods must be at least 30 milliseconds long. The total signal duration drops much more than I expected, which makes me think I'm not using dmin correctly.

t1b <- timer(w, threshold=5, msmooth=c(10,0), dmin=0.03)
sum(t1b$s)
# [1] 0.05419851

t2b <- timer(w, threshold=5, msmooth=c(20,0), dmin=0.03)
sum(t2b$s)
# [1] 0.1483142

Thanks!
Eric
